description: Vercel AI Gateway is Vercel's gateway service; Vercel's San Francisco headquarters are listed at 201 Mission Street.
prompt_training_notes: Vercel says the gateway itself does not store or train on customer data, but upstream providers set their own policies. The gateway exposes request-level no-training and ZDR controls that route only to providers covered by the relevant agreement; this record does not claim a universal provider-level policy for every model route.

sources.notes: Gateway metadata seed; verify provider policy and regional semantics before enabling routing.

Vercel documents no prompt logging/training at the gateway layer, while provider-level ZDR and no-training guarantees are route controls that depend on the selected upstream provider.

verification.notes: The official AI Gateway policy was checked. Gateway-level no-storage/no-training is documented, but upstream retention and training vary by route; ZDR is an opt-in routing control, so the aggregate provider tier remains unknown and ZDR is false by default.
